# Google Meet Integration Specification

## 1. Overview & Agentic Capabilities

The Google Meet integration enables **Fenr** and the **Nabu** agent to:
* **Provision Instant Meeting Spaces**: Generate persistent Google Meet meeting rooms and join links.
* **Conference Lifecycle Management**: Configure entry points, access restrictions, and co-hosts.
* **Retrieve Post-Meeting Artifacts**: Fetch meeting conference records, participant attendance, and meeting transcripts when generated by Google Meet.
* **Agent Meeting Preparation**: Provide meeting participants with Fenr context documents ahead of the call.

---

## 2. OAuth 2.0 & Scope Classification

Google Meet scopes are classified as **Sensitive, NOT Restricted**.
* **Audit Requirement**: **Free Google Trust & Safety verification**. No CASA Tier 2/3 security assessment fee.
* **Co-existence with Calendar**: For simple meeting link creation, the `calendar.events` scope (via `conferenceData`) is sufficient. The dedicated Google Meet API v2 is used when programmatic control over spaces and transcript artifacts is needed.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                           MEET SCOPE SPECTRUM                               │
│                                                                             │
│  [Sensitive - Free Google Verification, NO CASA Audit Needed]               │
│  • https://www.googleapis.com/auth/meetings.space.created                   │
│  • https://www.googleapis.com/auth/meetings.space.readonly                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Recommended Scopes

| Scope URI | Classification | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/meetings.space.created` | Sensitive | Create and manage meeting spaces created by the app. |
| `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/meetings.space.readonly` | Sensitive | Read space configuration and conference records. |

---

## 3. Core API Endpoints & Payload Contracts

All Meet calls target `https://meet.googleapis.com/v2/`.

### A. Create Persistent Meeting Space
* **Endpoint**: `POST /spaces`
* **Payload**:
  ```json
  {
    "config": {
      "accessType": "OPEN",
      "entryPointAccess": "ALL"
    }
  }
  ```
* **Response**: Returns `meetingUri` (e.g. `https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij`) and space name.

### B. Fetch Conference Records (Post-Meeting)
* **Endpoint**: `GET /conferenceRecords?filter=space.name="spaces/{spaceId}"`
* **Response**: Start time, end time, and participant session records.

### C. Retrieve Transcripts & Recordings
* **Endpoint**: `GET /conferenceRecords/{conferenceRecordId}/transcripts`
* **Response**: Lists transcript entries generated by Google Workspace automatic transcription.

---

## 4. Rate Limits & Quotas

* **Standard Quota**: 60 requests per minute per user.
* **Throttling**: Returns `429 Too Many Requests`. Standard exponential backoff.

---

```rust

    pub room_label: Option<String>,
    pub access_type: Option<String>, // "OPEN", "TRUSTED", "RESTRICTED"
}
```
